label: SR-RX lab +labN builds
notes: Origin srrx-lab is the 1001 stanza of etc/apt/preferences.d/lab.pref (repo/lab.pref); the mirrored noble snapshot is a separate publication with origin srrx-mirror at 990 (build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md section 2; the origin names were TBD there and are fixed here).

never_in_lab_repo_globs: kernel, bootloader/BIOS (SPI edk2), board firmware and DSP/FastRPC packages never come from the lab repository; they stay on the image at their held versions (build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md section 1.2 and section 24).

No Valid-Until in the Release file: the device is offline and its RTC may be wrong. Freshness is the reviewed release record instead: offline_snapshot.inrelease_sha256 pins one exact signed InRelease, so an older signed publication is refused.
status DRAFT until the owner's offline key ceremony (repo/README.md) fixes the release fingerprint; CI signs only with a throwaway test key.
